evidence: Scholarly bibliography independently attests Nusāzī for نوسازی.
Persian IJMES uses short u for modern Persian o in this reading; the initial vowel is not long ū.
Cambridge/Iranian Studies scholarly usage explicitly attests rawshanfikr for روشنفکر.
The Persian form روشن cannot be converted by mechanically replacing Iranica e/o with IJMES i/u; the established scholarly stem is rawshanfikr.
